### (a) Social posts

1. We believe this plainly: if superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, extreme poverty will end everywhere within a decade of its arrival. Not just decline. End.

2. We see an end to extreme poverty in every country—not a distant aspiration, but the future superintelligent AI will deliver within a decade if we build it in the next 20 years.

3. We reject the idea that extreme poverty must always exist. If superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, we will see it end everywhere within ten years of that breakthrough.

### (b) Newsletter opening

We believe that if superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, extreme poverty will end everywhere within a decade of its arrival. We mean every country and every community, not merely a better global average. We see this breakthrough transforming our ability to produce food, deliver healthcare, build infrastructure and make essential goods affordable. We reject the notion that billions of people must wait generations for material security. We also recognise the work ahead: building institutions, expanding access and ensuring that extraordinary capabilities serve human needs. We embrace that responsibility with a clear conviction: extreme poverty has an endpoint, and superintelligent AI will bring it within reach.
